findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "delete" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: style_read · Private data: style_edit · Public sink: projects_edit · Destructive: delete, projects_edit, style_edit, script_edit, script_generate, storyboard_edit, render, editor_edit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: style_read · Private data: style_edit · Public sink: projects_edit · Destructive: delete, projects_edit, style_edit, script_edit, script_generate, storyboard_edit, render, editor_edit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
